input.title: Preserve source roster and boss selection draws
input.body:
## Summary

Roster candidates used a floor-based pick, and the single builtin boss bypassed selection entirely. Both differ from the recovered rounded sampler and shift later encounter/Setup randomness.

```text
roster pool → rounded 0..count-1 index
fresh boss gate → source 1..bossCount draw → construction / Setup → pose
```

This is layer 3 of the five-layer stack, based on [#136](https://github.com/ianwijma/open-bubble-tank/pull/136). Hold master until all five layers are assembled into the last PR and its combined head passes. The existing offline pool policy and boss eligibility gate stay explicit.

## Evidence

- **Before:** all three new regressions fail. Raw 0.33 chooses the wrong entry in three-candidate builtin/saved pools, and a boss field starts with a Setup draw instead of source's 1..1 selection draw.
  **After:** the rounded candidate index and leading boss draw pass; the preceding complete Setup-before-pose assertions remain intact.
- Formatting, TypeScript and 922 unit tests / 8,478 assertions pass. The independent pcode-template audit still passes all 1,344 cases and visits all 99 constructor sites.
- Production build and all 14 affected mock/supplied-art browser cases pass with zero skips, flaky results or page errors. Accelerated pilots reach six upgrades, boss defeat, badge and Continue in 80,162 mock / 81,551 supplied-art frames. Native history/win/targeting paint inspected; owned servers stopped.
- Matching GetLocalTank / _-De bytecode and PlayerProfile's leading boss sentinel establish the selection contracts. [The source reference](https://github.com/ianwijma/open-bubble-tank/blob/stack/wave-selection-03-encounter-selection/docs/wave-selection-reference.md#roster-candidate-indices-and-boss-selection) records exact commands, hashes, build and limits.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

No saved-data migration or original media.

**Blast Radius:** gameplay

Seeded encounters and subsequent RNG consumption change. Offline pool construction/order, retired server scheduling, empty/missing records and the complete constructor/art random stream remain separate limits. Seeded accelerated tests do not prove ordinary-input or original/Adobe/full-game equivalence. The branch retains the existing `stack/**` deployment control.

Created with gpt-6.1-sol in T3 Code's Codex harness.
